Timeout below the default 120 s because every wait in the script is bounded by the script itself - 5 s for each pause and a 2 s bounded call for the run with the breakpoints cleared - and each raises an error naming what it was waiting for, so a lower timeout is what gets a diagnosis rather than a bare HarnessTimeout a minute later.
